t: Rajan spent 10% of his salary on rent. He spent 20% of the remaining part of the salary on transport. After which he spent 40% of the balance of the salary on food. Money deposited in the bank and saved for his own petty expenditure = Rs. (5000 + 1480) = Rs. 6480

8.64x = 6480
100x = (6480/8.64)* 100 = 75,000
